_comment: Machine-checkable facts about this Jira/Xray instance. Verify with .claude/scripts/verify-environment.mjs — never hand-edit a value here to make the check pass without finding out who changed it and why.

people._comment: Who to tag on a QA-scope comment. Requirements engineers answer contradictions inside a spec; a front-end developer is needed as well when the spec describes something the code does not do. Only REs and developers are tagged — the rest are here so roles are clear when reading a changelog.

ownership._comment: The whole header was built in one go, with AI, by Sybrand Lubbe — so the changelog does not attribute these tickets individually and who-built.mjs falls back to the lead for most of them. For anything in the header family, tag Sybrand rather than the fallback. Recorded 2026-08-26; later sprints are expected to follow a clearer per-ticket process, at which point this note should go.
